title: Fix every violation of one lint rule (ESLint or Biome)

params.name: rule
params.description: The ESLint rule ID (e.g. prefer-const) or Biome rule (e.g. style/useConst or lint/style/useConst) to fix.

preconditions: ESLint or Biome is installed locally and configured with the rule enabled.
At least one violation of the rule at the baseline.

criteria.pass: The linter reports zero violations of the rule, no new disable or ignore comments or linter config changes, and the test script passes.
criteria.partial: Violations dropped but not to zero, or they reached zero by disabling or ignoring the rule, changing the linter configuration, or tests fail.
criteria.fail: The violation count did not drop, or the linter could not run.
